name: Append to File
description: Append to a file under a configured filesystem root or at an authorised DLFS path, creating it if absent. Supply exactly one of content, value, bytes, or contentRef.
creator: Covia

root.description: Configured root name; omit for a canonical DLFS path

path.description: Path relative to root or a canonical DLFS file path

value.description: JSON-serialisable value to append as UTF-8 JSON

contentRef.description: Resolvable content reference to stream, including an asset, file:// root path, or DLFS path

created.description: True if the file was newly created
